card.name: Linking words in anesthesia dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of' or 'or', or the space or digit inside a number range, in anesthesia dosing text. It appears just before an anesthetic drug name or amount (propofol, DIPRIVAN, desflurane, rocuronium).

modes.label: 'of' before anesthetic
modes.description: The word 'of' after a dose, depth or level, right before an anesthetic drug or the word anesthesia.
modes.example: require 2 mg/kg to 2.5 mg/kg<< of>> DIPRIVAN for induction when

modes.label: Inside number ranges
modes.description: The space or first digit within a dose or rate range in anesthesia dosing.
modes.example: The induction dose usually provides anesthesia for 5 to<< >>7 minutes Maintenance of anesthesia

modes.label: 'or' between induction drugs
modes.description: The word 'or' between two induction agents, ahead of propofol.
modes.example: After induction in adults with an intravenous drug such as thiopental<< or>> propof
